mapper.select: with counts as ( select 'SCHEDULED_OCCURRENCE' as scope, case when run.run_status is not null then 'RUN_' || run.run_status else occurrence.occurrence_status end as status, count(*) as count from batch.scheduled_occurrence occurrence left join batch.trigger_request request on request.tenant_id = occurrence.tenant_id and request.request_id = occurrence.request_id and request.workflow_definition_id = occurrence.workflow_definition_id and request.biz_date is not distinct from occurrence.biz_date and request.dry_run = false left join batch.workflow_run run on run.tenant_id = request.tenant_id and run.trigger_request_id = request.id and run.workflow_definition_id = occurrence.workflow_definition_id and run.biz_date is not distinct from occurrence.biz_date and run.dry_run = false where occurrence.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and occurrence.biz_date = #{bizDate} and occurrence.occurrence_status != 'SUPERSEDED' group by case when run.run_status is not null then 'RUN_' || run.run_status else occurrence.occurrence_status end union all select 'TRIGGER_REQUEST', request_status, count(*) from batch.trigger_request where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and biz_date = #{bizDate} and dry_run = false and workflow_definition_id is not null and parent_workflow_run_id is null group by request_status union all select 'WORKFLOW_RUN', run_status, count(*) from batch.workflow_run where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and biz_date = #{bizDate} and dry_run = false group by run_status union all select 'JOB_INSTANCE', instance_status, count(*) from batch.job_instance where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and biz_date = #{bizDate} and dry_run = false group by instance_status union all select 'JOB_TASK', task.task_status, count(*) from batch.job_task task join batch.job_instance job on job.tenant_id = task.tenant_id and job.id = task.job_instance_id and job.biz_date = #{bizDate} and job.dry_run = false where task.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and task.dry_run = false and (task.job_instance_biz_date = #{bizDate} or task.job_instance_biz_date is null) group by task.task_status ) select scope, status, count from counts order by scope, status

select count(*) as scheduled, count(*) filter (where day.cutoff_at is null or workflow.schedule_type not in ('CRON','FIXED_RATE') or not exists ( select 1 from batch.scheduled_occurrence_coverage coverage where coverage.tenant_id = workflow.tenant_id and coverage.workflow_definition_id = workflow.id and coverage.schedule_version = workflow.version and coverage.calendar_code is not distinct from workflow.calendar_code and coverage.coverage_from_at <= day.cutoff_at and coverage.coverage_through_at >= day.cutoff_at and coverage.last_success_at >= coalesce((select revision.updated_at from batch.tenant_configuration_revision revision where revision.tenant_id = workflow.tenant_id), '-infinity'::timestamptz) )) as uncovered from batch.workflow_definition workflow left join batch.batch_day_instance day on day.tenant_id = workflow.tenant_id and day.calendar_code = workflow.calendar_code and day.biz_date = #{bizDate} where workflow.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and workflow.enabled = true and workflow.schedule_enabled = true and workflow.schedule_type not in ('MANUAL','EVENT') and workflow.trigger_mode in ('SCHEDULED','MIXED')
